_readme: The 'Off the clock' personal section. Games render as save-slot cards, anime as a ranked list — both sorted by 'rank' (1 = favorite), so renumbering reorders them automatically. 'stat' (games) and 'status' (anime) are optional short mono lines rendered uppercase; omit them and nothing renders. Field docs: src/lib/content.ts.
intro: Off the clock I'm usually gaming or watching anime. Current favorites, ranked.

games.title: Minecraft
games.blurb: The game I always come back to. Redstone was my first real introduction to logic and debugging.

games.title: Genshin Impact
games.blurb: Beautiful open world, even better soundtrack.

games.title: Brawl Stars
games.blurb: Quick matches that fit perfectly between classes.

anime.title: Steins;Gate
anime.blurb: My favorite piece of fiction, period — and the reason this site looks the way it does.

anime.title: Attack on Titan
anime.blurb: Years of setup that all pays off. Some of the best long-form storytelling I've seen.

anime.title: My Hero Academia
anime.blurb: My comfort series — earnest in a way I'll always respect.
